| Image = [[Image:Banoffeepie.jpg|300px]]
}}
{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Dessert|Dessert]] | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the United Kingdom|UK Cuisine]]

==Ingredients==
*9 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] (250 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] / 16 ea.) gingernut (or [[Cookbook:Digestive Biscuit|digestive]]) biscuits
*10 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] (275 g / 2¼ sticks) [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]] 
*1 tin (400 g / 14 oz) [[Cookbook:Sweetened Condensed Milk|sweetened condensed milk]]
*6 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] (175 g / ¾ cup) [[Cookbook:Caster Sugar|caster sugar]]
*¼ [[Cookbook:Pint|pint]] (150 [[Cookbook:mL|ml]] / ⅔ cup) [[Cookbook:Double Cream|double cream]]
*2 [[Cookbook:Banana|bananas]]

==Procedure==

=== Base ===

# Crush the biscuits into crumbs with the end of a [[Cookbook:Rolling Pin|rolling pin]]. This is best done inside a freezer bag to avoid spillage and loss.
# Melt two-fifths of the butter (about 4 oz) in a large [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]]. Once melted, take off the heat and mix in the biscuit crumbs.
# Press into the bottom of an 8-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] (20 cm) loose-bottomed [[Cookbook:Pie Pan|pie tin]], and transfer to the fridge to chill.

=== Filling ===

# Place the remaining butter with the sugar into a medium-sized saucepan (ideally non-stick if you don't like dish washing). Melt over a medium heat, stirring until the butter has melted and the sugar is just starting to melt.
# Add the condensed milk and bring to the boil, stirring continuously for 5 minutes to make your caramel.

=== Assembly ===

# Slice the bananas, arrange over the crumb base, and pour the caramel over the top.
# Chill for at least an hour so the caramel firms up.
# Prior to serving, [[Cookbook:Whipping|whip]] the cream, and spoon over the top. Optionally, garnish with some grated chocolate or [[Cookbook:Cape Gooseberry|Cape gooseberries]].

==Warnings==
*If there are children present, it is practically impossible to keep them from licking the contents of the condensed milk tin! Be careful of the edges.
